correctness.rationale: For n>=3 each C_n□K3 vertex has four distinct neighbors, with tie retaining own color. It is fixed precisely if its own opinion occurs in at most two neighbors (at least two opposite). In a pair-of-columns 64x64 de Bruijn transfer, 218 transitions satisfy the central-three-bit test. Closed walks of length n correspond bijectively to labelled cyclic fixed states, so U_n=trace(T^n). Reconstructed exact integer charpoly X^40(X-2)(X-1)^3(X+1)^3(X²+X+1)^3p(X)q(X)^2, p=X³−3X²−3X+2, q=X⁴+X³+4X²−3X+3. Its eigenvalue-power trace yields U_n=2^n+3(-1)^n+9[3|n]+S_p(n)+2S_q(n). Cubic has one root lambda in (3,4), other two in (-2,-1),(0,1); on |z|=3 the degree-4 term of q dominates the remaining coefficients (81>75), proving all other roots <3. Thus U_n=lambda^n+O(3^n) and entropy log(lambda)/3. Independently exact charpoly checked and directly enumerated fixed states n3..7 =102,188,510,2918,9240.
residual_risks: Exactly n>=3, labelled 4-regular cylindrical graph, tie-retaining open-neighbor minority; no characterization of periods>1.
